bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
old="sha256:4d4ab3395ce4c250dc40ca179bbac7598d149288cac2381b54e11e7a719b6f5c"
new="sha256:f7e190067630b9ba474aebd768b313f0bf0a288475638cf7acda10392a08afdf"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$old"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)" = "$old"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:startless-pr71-20261122)" = "$new"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-startless-pr71-20261122)" = "$old"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test ! -e deploy/state/startless-pr71-deploy-20261122.json
expected="$(sha256sum deploy/state/startless-pr71-stage/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)"
docker image tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:startless-pr71-20261122 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
if ! docker compose -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml up -d --no-deps --no-build gaybbs >/dev/null; then
 docker image tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-startless-pr71-20261122 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml up -d --no-deps --no-build gaybbs >/dev/null || true
 exit 70
fi
if test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" != true || test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" != "$new" || test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "$expected"; then
 docker image tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-startless-pr71-20261122 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml up -d --no-deps --no-build gaybbs >/dev/null || true
 exit 71
fi
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("/app/gaybbs.mjs","utf8");if(!s.includes("STARTLESS_REPEATED_START_LINK_FORBIDDEN")||!s.includes("gdm:"))process.exit(2)'
printf '{"state":"VERIFIED","scope":"common public-navigation adapter only","old_image":"%s","new_image":"%s","new_bundle_sha256":"%s","userbot_service":"unchanged"}\n' "$old" "$new" "$expected" > deploy/state/startless-pr71-deploy-20261122.json
echo "STARTLESS_RUNTIME_CALLBACK_GUARD_VERIFIED=PASS"
